name: User sudo
description: Runs one operation as another user, with that user's whole authority: what it does and makes is the user's, and the caller is its caller. Requires admin/sudo on the target DID, from a request no access token or callable narrows; the venue's own DID and its public principal cannot be targets. Acts that need the user in person, such as answering their approval requests, extracting a secret or minting their identity token, refuse it.

did.description: Target user DID the nested operation runs as
